features.quote: EARLY BIRD HOTEL PACKAGE: Accommodation for 2 nights in a luxury room + Breakfast + Unlimited Wellness.
features.rationale: The hotel package explicitly includes accommodation for two nights.

features.quote: Stay right in the center of the action in the beautiful setting of Hotel Pod Lipou Resort.
features.rationale: The accommodation is at the same resort hotel where the event is held, so event and stay share one venue.

features.quote: We offer flexible meal packages (Friday dinner + Saturday lunch/dinner).
features.rationale: Meals are offered as a package covering specific dinners and lunches.
The event explicitly provides a minimum of 18 hours of dance workshops.
